harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (systemd-managed, ports 2379/2380 opened in firewalld), loaded application keys under /app/, simulated the permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir), removed the dead member via etcdctl, added a new member for node3 with the same peer URL and ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, and confirmed it rejoined, caught up via raft, and now serves the original application keys. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart-evidence protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart cluster/data health each time.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries (etcd, etcdctl, etcdutl) on node1, node2, node3 from the official GitHub release tarball
Created etcd system user, /etc/etcd config, and systemd unit on each node; opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 on all three nodes
Bootstrapped a new 3-member etcd cluster (node1=10.100.60.10, node2=10.100.60.11, node3=10.100.60.12) and verified all members started and healthy
Wrote application keys /app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flags, /app/secrets/api_key as the baseline data set
Captured pre-disruption boot IDs for all three nodes

Simulated permanent loss of the node3 etcd member: stopped/disabled the etcd service and deleted /var/lib/etcd contents on node3, while node1+node2 retained quorum and continued serving all application keys

Removed the dead member via 'member remove' using node1/node2 quorum, then added a new member for node3 ('member add', same peer URL) and reconfigured/started etcd on node3 with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing
Verified the replaced node3 member joined, synced via raft, and serves the original application keys; confirmed cluster returned to 3/3 healthy members
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified etcd active with full cluster health/data restored
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified etcd active with full cluster health/data restored
Restarted node3 (the replaced member) via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified etcd active with full cluster health, member list, raft sync, and data restored

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster established with application keys
evidence.summary: member list/health show 3 started+healthy members; app keys written and read back
boot_id captured for node1, node2, node3 before any restart

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (data destroyed) while quorum preserved
evidence.summary: etcd stopped and /var/lib/etcd wiped on node3; node1+node2 endpoint health and /app data confirmed intact via quorum

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and new member added/joined on node3
evidence.summary: member remove of old node3 ID, member add of new node3 ID, etcd started active on node3 with existing-cluster state

evidence.requirement: Cluster back to three healthy members with existing keys intact
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members synced at raft index 22; new node3 member locally serves all original /app keys

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: pre-restart health/data check, reboot issued (stream closed = ack), new boot_id 16c95c08..., post-restart 3/3 health+member list+data confirmed

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: pre-restart boot_id/active check, reboot issued, new boot_id ecedd48f..., post-restart 3/3 health+member list+data confirmed

evidence.requirement: node3 (replaced member) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state and cluster membership
evidence.summary: pre-restart boot_id/active check, reboot issued, new boot_id 345f84ed..., post-restart 3/3 health, member list, raft-synced status (index 38), and app keys confirmed
